product_contract.permission_actions: English denied and granted permission actions remain visible, hittable, correctly labeled, and at most 36 points tall.
product_contract.settings_geometry: Cards retain their preferred geometry across wide, narrow, language, and theme transitions while controls use content-aware widths.
product_contract.dropdowns: Language selection exposes its live intrinsic width and hotkey key menus use the right-side placement when the full menu fits.
product_contract.logs: The Logs surface exposes its content anchor and complete verbose-runtime warning copy.
product_contract.app_visibility: The Manage action is hittable and opens the localized App Visibility manager.
product_contract.search: A delivered search trigger presents the search input and seeded result while keeping the panel's row budget and top anchor stable.
product_contract.localization: English and Simplified Chinese permission content remains visible within the same component geometry contract.

production_path: AppKitSettingsPage composes card rows and resolves single-column or two-column geometry from the available width.
PermissionSettingsCard applies compact action metrics, localized state, and stable accessibility identifiers.
AppVisibilitySettingsCard routes its compact Manage action into AppVisibilityManagerView.
AppLogsView and RuntimeLogsSection publish the Logs content anchor, warning copy, dropdown, and compact actions.
AppLocalization supplies English and Simplified Chinese labels consumed during relayout.
SwitcherPanelSearchBridge publishes the search input and sizes visible rows while the panel controller preserves its top anchor.
Existing XCUI tests exercise the signed fixed App through the same public accessibility surfaces.
